explanation.what: `PastBound` has a TSDoc comment (`/** ... */`), but it is internal to the package. `packages/pipeline/src/index.ts` exports only `type Install` and `InstalledPackagesError` from this module, so `PastBound` is not part of the package's API. One of a class: the TSDoc on `Install.read` (line 44) and on the `outside`/`unrecognised` fields is acceptable because `Install` is exported, so this is the one clear instance.
explanation.whatToDo: Make it a plain `//` line comment, or remove it.
explanation.whyHere: AGENTS.md, Code section: "TSDoc only on exported package API. Nothing on internals."

properties.failureScenario: Someone reading `installed-packages.ts` sees TSDoc on `PastBound` and takes it to be public package API. It is not: `index.ts` does not re-export it, so callers of `@melian-agent/pipeline` cannot import it. The rule keeps TSDoc as the marker of exported API, and this comment breaks that.
